goal: Materialize an immutable, complete local dependency closure for the Isaac Sim 5.1 H1 ground asset; bind it through ISAACSIM_ASSET_ROOT and the 5.1 Kit asset-root setting; fail closed before AppLauncher on drift, missing dependencies, or network fallback; independently validate CPU regressions and prepare one exact new D0008 smoke proposal without launching it or formal training.

criteria.description: A collected Isaac Sim 5.1 ground asset closure contains the exact USD and every texture/material dependency with source URLs, sizes and SHA256 values.
The local asset root is fixed, read-only, committed, and bound by a canonical manifest and tree identity.

ISAACSIM_ASSET_ROOT is an exact required runtime input and is translated to the Isaac Sim 5.1 persistent asset-root Kit setting without changing product, method, actor, reward, thresholds or training arithmetic.
A pre-AppLauncher closure check opens and hashes all required local USD, texture and material files and fails closed before any live start if anything is missing, drifted, symlinked or remote.
Affected CPU tests and independent validation pass on a clean frozen candidate, including failure-path and environment propagation coverage.
A new exact D0008 smoke proposal binds the final candidate, product, control release, runtime, asset manifest, authorization, limits and no-retry conditions and remains unapproved/unsubmitted.

tasks.text: Inspect the D0007 immutable failure, collect the exact default_environment.usd dependency closure from the Isaac Sim 5.1 asset root, verify provenance and every byte, bind the local root through ISAACSIM_ASSET_ROOT and the version-supported Kit setting, add a pre-AppLauncher no-network closure gate, preserve the accepted product/method/training arithmetic, run independent CPU tests and closure audits, freeze the resulting candidate, then prepare but do not approve or submit a new exact D0008 smoke specification. Do not reuse D0007 authority, start a simulator, query GPU, start formal training, merge, or push.
